thread:
maria: Heads-up — PM asked for a comparative rollout regression dashboard that combines runtime and infra inputs (wanting quick triage for regressions across models/routes/regions). Can we align what telemetry pieces we need and a wire contract by EOW?

jason: Quick q — are we aiming for a delta-only view (canary vs control) or full timeseries + diff?

maria: Ideally both. Primary landing should be a heatmap/diff matrix that shows per-slice regression score, with ability to drill to timeseries + raw traces. PM emphasized 'fast triage' not raw logs. :clock10:

tanvi: For slices, we'll need route, model_version, region, tenant_id (when applicable), and a user-signal slice. Also we should normalize for traffic volume to avoid noisy small-sample slices.

ashok: From runtime side I can feed: p50/p95 latency, token/sec, mean batch size, queue_depth, KV-cache hit rate, OOM_count, inference_error_count, model_fallback_rate. All exposed as Prometheus counters/gauges + 1m/5m rate windows.

kevin: Console/UX ask: make the primary key "slice_id" and expose human labels so the dashboard can auto-aggregate. We also want a lightweight regression_score metric (single number per slice per interval) so the heatmap ranks the worst regressions first.

ashok: proposing a simple regression_score = weighted_change(latency, error_rate, fallback_rate) with sample-size correction. I can compute and emit as a timeseries in runtime metrics pipeline (kafka -> metrics-processor -> prometheus).

dev-bot: sample contract proto (sketch):
```
{
  "slice_id": "string",
  "labels": ["route", "model", "region"],
  "interval_start": "iso8601",
  "interval_end": "iso8601",
  "p50_latency_ms": "float",
  "p95_latency_ms": "float",
  "error_rate": "float",
  "fallback_rate": "float",
  "tokens_per_sec": "float",
  "request_count": "int",
  "regression_score": "float"
}
```

ashok: Will add regression_score and publish an example topic in the infra-kafka namespace today.

ashok: note: for very small request_count (<50) we should set regression_score = NaN and show faded in the heatmap. Avoid false positives.

kevin: Dashboard plumbing: Grafana panel that queries prometheus_regression_score by slice over last 1h/6h/24h and renders a heatmap (rows=slices, cols=time-interval). Drill-through clicks open per-slice timeseries (p50/p95/error) and link to traces in Tempo.

tanvi: Telemetry alignment: we need consistent interval boundaries (UTC minute-aligned) and the canonical label keys. I'll push a small schema PR to github.com/redwood/telemetry-schemas with the labels list.

ashok: tagging here @kevin @tanvi when I push the topic and example payload. Also I'll emit a separate prometheus metric `runtime_regression_score_bucket{slice_id="..."}` for histogram-style alerts.

jason: Alerting: SRE needs a baseline and an automated diff alert (e.g., regression_score delta > 0.2 AND request_count > 500 over last 15m). Otherwise too many noise pings.

srebot: Agree. We can create grouped alerting rules that dedupe by slice_id and route to the rollout-oncall channel. Suggest initial severity=P2.

maria: Ops ask: add a UI toggle to only show slices with request_count > X and to hide NaN rows. Also include a small 'impact estimate' column (est daily additional token cost) so PMs can prioritize.

kevin: UX note — for A/B experiments we need to compute pairwise deltas and a small quick-stat test (bootstrap CI) shown inline. We can initially show a simple delta and p-val placeholder.

ashok: timeline: I'll emit contract + sample topic today. Tanvi — can you land the schema PR tomorrow? Kevin — can you prototype the Grafana heatmap and panel queries by mid-week? Jason/SRE — can you draft alert thresholds?

jason: I'll take alerts. Will sync with SRE after you push example payloads.

maria: Awesome. Quick checklist in thread: 1) schema PR (tanvi) 2) example topic + payload (ashok) 3) grafana prototype (kevin) 4) alert thresholds (jason + sre) 5) console UI toggles (kevin). Please update status in-thread. :white_check_mark:

kevin: I'll post a prototype link once panel is rendering sample data.

ashok: posted example topic -> kafka://infra-rollouts.regression-samples topic at 1837660000 with zipped example payloads. @kevin @tanvi

maria: Thanks all. Follow-ups in #eng-platform meeting tomorrow 10:30 to lock cutover plan.
